strengths: Clear structure with distinct sections for experience, projects, and education
Strong alignment of skills (Python, SQL, React) with common junior developer roles
Demonstrates full-stack capability by listing backend (Flask), database (SQL), and frontend (React) technologies
ai_recommendations.summary_rewrite: Junior software developer specializing in full-stack development with Python, SQL, and React. Proven experience building scalable APIs and accessible dashboards while implementing automated testing frameworks.
weak_points: Summary lacks specific years of experience or concrete project outcomes to establish credibility
Action verbs are generic ('Built') without context on scale, team size, or business impact

Project description is too vague and fails to highlight technical challenges solved
Skills section lists tools rather than demonstrating proficiency levels or specific frameworks used
